note: Inspected receiver-declared digest/length and bounded HTTP body import through Store private staging and atomic publication; restart-from-zero retries ignore digest-named partial paths, rate limits back off with bounded attempts, and conditional/reuse hits rehash stored bytes. Loopback tests cover truncation, length/digest mismatch, overlong chunked bodies, 429/503 recovery and ETag/304. Removing the expected store digest produced a real TestExpectedError assertion. Refreshed tests overwrite a committed blob with different bytes of exactly the original length; both 304 and explicit reuse refuse it, proving a byte/digest check rather than a size-only check.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
